cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Be There for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Come paint the old kitchen with me. Since Dad died, I barely see you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay someone. I can't face painting over his height marks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. We'll keep them. Come help me tape around them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probably just sit on the floor and cry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll sit with you. We can leave the paint unopened; I don't want us only meeting to empty his house.

mechanism: A treats its grieving sibling as an old practical pupil, revising the painting lesson into simple shared presence to keep their connection alive.
confusable: Not needing the decorating done: A accepts no painting if B will come and stay connected.
comparison: Sibling bereavement/company versus parent attendance under divorce pressure.
